```scala
package examples.dsl

import scala.language.implicitConversions

import menger.dsl._

/**
 * A level-2 Menger sponge: the classic volume-filling sponge with the first two
 * subdivisions (400 cubes), in gold, lit by a three-point key/fill/rim setup over a dark floor.
 */
object MengerSponge:
  val scene = Scene(
    camera = Camera(
      position = (4f, 3f, 6f),
      lookAt = (0f, 0f, 0f)
    ),
    objects = List(
      Sponge(
        pos = (0f, 0f, 0f),
        spongeType = VolumeFilling,
        level = 2f,
        material = Some(Material.Gold),
        size = 2.5f
      )
    ),
    lights = List(
      Directional(
        direction = (1f, -1f, -1f),
        intensity = 1.5f
      ),
      Directional(
        direction = (-1f, -0.5f, -1f),
        intensity = 0.5f
      ),
      Directional(
        direction = (0f, 0.5f, 1f),
        intensity = 0.8f
      )
    ),
    planes = List(Plane(Y at -3, color = "#404040"))
  )

  SceneRegistry.register("menger-sponge", scene)
```
level-2 volume-filling sponge, 2.5 units, gold, three directional lights (one from above, one from above, one from below), dark grey floor at y=-3, camera 7.8 units out looking at the origin.
